item.title: Tali Takes 14 – New semester, new beginnings
item.description: In this episode of Tali Takes, executive editor Clarissa Dean and design editor Breanna Burba talk all things Talisman. This semester, we are approaching the podcast from a different angle in a different environment. From a recap on website stories to a sneak peek on what to expect, you won’t want to miss this episode! Check out this episode on Spotify and YouTube. item.description: Photos by Carlee Hite and Ella Oakley WKU Best Buddies hosted their annual Fashion 4 Friendship in the Downing Student Union Auditorium on Thursday, Feb. 12.
